result.title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
result.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code, frozen outputs, and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/tofuadmiral/institutional-representation-abm
result.summary: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把多智能体系统中审查者能否推翻上游决策形式化为「管辖权限」问题：在相同提议、任务信息与模型下，比较宽泛覆盖权与「证据门控」（审查者需给出可机械校验的约束违反记录与合规修复才允许替换），在两个本地开源模型、96 个空间政策任务和迁移基准上测量纠错收益与污染正确提议的代价，并用「保留/替换/升级」接口做前瞻验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 「须提供可校验证据方可覆盖既有决策」的门控机制可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据何时足以推翻语言先验答案、以及保留/替换/升级的决策授权条件；其「接口设计并非模型无关保障」的结论也可作为迁移时的警示。
